lastCompletedStory.title: Capture the suite gate's combined output in check-all

nextStoryContext: scripts/check-all.ts now exports decodeCapturedOutput(result: { stdout?: Buffer; stderr?: Buffer }): string (stdout-decoded text followed by stderr-decoded text; missing buffers decode to '') and RunGatesOptions.onSuiteOutput?: (output: string) => void, invoked exactly once per runGates() call, right after the suite ('test') gate's spawnFn call, with the combined blob. The suite gate now runs `bun test --coverage` (was `bun test`) and is the only gate spawned with piped stdio (both streams); every other gate keeps inherited stdio via the same SpawnFn seam (widened to SyncSubprocess<'pipe'|'inherit','pipe'|'inherit'>). The next stories (coverage/skip-ratchet, per the CAM-488 PRD) should wire their own gate entries in scripts/check-all.ts's runGates call site to consume onSuiteOutput's blob instead of re-invoking `bun test --coverage` / `bun test` themselves inside check-coverage.ts / check-skip-ratchet.ts. GOTCHA (found and fixed this story, keep in mind for similar wiring elsewhere): `options.onSuiteOutput?.(makeExpensiveThing())` short-circuits the ARGUMENT evaluation (not just the call) when onSuiteOutput is undefined, per JS optional-chaining semantics -- if the echo/write-through side effect must always happen regardless of whether a consumer callback is present, compute it into a local first, then pass the local to the optional call: `const x = makeExpensiveThing(); options.onSuiteOutput?.(x);`. This was caught by AC2's own oracle going RED on the first implementation attempt (a fake spawnFn with no onSuiteOutput option produced no SENTINELOUT/SENTINELERR echo at all) before the fix. Full bun run check:all spine (all 14 gates) confirmed green end-to-end on this branch after the fix.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Confirmed Bun.spawnSync defaults: stdout defaults to 'pipe', stderr defaults to 'inherit' (asymmetric); the implementation always sets both stdout and stderr explicitly per invocation (never relies on either default), matching the pinned mechanism in this story's notes.
